purpose: Say where this sits, what it replaces, and confirm the department it was already filed under.

questions.question: What do you do today without it?
Does it replace or extend something you already have? Name it, or say nothing.
It files under <department> - <charter title>: <charter purpose>. Keep it there, or move it?
Anything you would want to track about it over time?

artifact: the Strategy rows of APP.md; no code and no second file

rules.rule: The department is stated, never interviewed. The chat prints the pinned department with its charter title and purpose and offers only keep or move; a move goes through the assign action. The pin travels as the pin option on the session call, never as seed text.
Only the department ref is persisted. An unknown ref reads as Unassigned, never as the root.
The charter title and purpose are quoted from the registry, never written by the chat. No charter means the row says 'no charter yet'.
rules.enforced_by: C6, which skips with a note when the registry cannot be read

rules.rule: 'Replaces or extends' names an existing app, or a non-app thing in plain words, or says nothing. Naming an existing app offers to archive it; archive is a status change.
rules.enforced_by: C9 (advisory); archive is a structured change in the edit chat

rules.rule: Review is a date and only a date. No owner is invented, no reminder is scheduled, no meeting is created.
rules.sutra_source: sutra-defaults.json (no operational capacity for human rituals)
rules.enforced_by: C7 parses the date; nothing schedules anything

rules.rule: Publishability is a yes/no/not sure answer. The chat never asks for semver, author, license or homepage and never writes a publish block.
rules.sutra_source: ADR-039 Decision; app-manifest.schema.json publish; APPS-THREATS.md X-9

checks.what: The Department row names a ref that equals module.json department.ref, and its charter text equals the registry's title and purpose.
checks.evaluator: ref matches ^dref-[0-9a-f]{16}$ and equals the manifest value; direct placement_engine import reads the charter registry from disk (the same file read modules_api.py uses); registry unreadable or no charter returns SKIP 'charter not read', never FAIL; no department passes when the row reads Unassigned; a row that names a department while the manifest has none FAILs (assign it, or write Unassigned)

checks.what: The P6 answer carries a date that parses as YYYY-MM-DD and is not earlier than created_at.
checks.evaluator: pattern plus date compare against module.json created_at

checks.what: The chat authored no publish block.
checks.evaluator: publish absent or null passes; a server-owned publish.state of exported, imported, published, update_available or incompatible with only the keys the desktop writes (state, checksum, version, published_at, registry, source) passes; any other authored publish keys FAIL naming them

checks.what: When S2 names an app id, that folder exists; WARN when the replaced app is still status ready.
checks.evaluator: when the cell matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ stat <home>/<id>/module.json and read status; plain words pass
